name: GetSuite
description: Installs native downloading applications in one LXC, with optional named-provider Gluetun VPN protection and connection verification.

notes.text: The selected applications share one LXC, one backup boundary, and one failure domain.
Gluetun requires TUN passthrough. GetSuite enables it in the generated LXC configuration.
Use 'getsuite vpn status' to verify VPN protection and 'getsuite add' to install another supported downloading application.
